translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Corintios

content: An-daedba be damar, igi an Cristo-daedba gudimoga.
Gwenadgan Bab Dummadse gollalir, igi daer-gebe
Gwenadgan an be-nug ogannomar, ar bemar an-iedisurmalad, degine, igi an be-odurdaksamala, amba bemar deyob nue ganimalad.
Bemar nue-wisgubi an be-abemardo, Cristo we bela-machergan-e-nonoga gued, degine, machergan, omegan-nonoga gumogad, degine, Bab Dummad Cristo-nonoga gusimogad.
Bela dule-machergan nonogi-gurgin-sii Bab Dummadse golele, igi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba barsogele, gwen nabirsurdo, e-nonogi istar binsananaiyobdo, Cristogi-dodonaiyob gunaido.
Ar omedi nono-dunwesuli Bab Dummadse gorgwichile, igi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-abingasad-barsoggwichile, gwen nabirsulid, e-nonogi istar binsananaiyob gunaido, ar sailagia-gwiri na isayobdo.
Ar ome-wargwen na e-nono dunwesulile, bur bela saila-gwiri-siked nabirid. Ar ome na saila-siked binge-itogele, igi, nono-gwiri-saed binge-itogele, ar degirdi na nono dunwesundo.
Ar machereddi nono-dunwed abelesulid, ar ade Bab-Dummad-yopiraa-dakleged-wilub na san-sediid, degine, dule-macheredba Bab-Dummad-nug ogannolegoed. Machereddi e-omeba nug ogannolemogoed.
Ar machered omegi danisulid, ome macheredgi danikid.
Deginbali, Bab Dummad, machered omega obinnissulid, Bab Dummad, ome macheredga obinnisad.
Degisoggu, a-ulale ome e-nono dunwer-gebed, adi mag daklegegar, machered-urbalii daed, deginbali, angermar dakmogagar, ome machered-urbalii nanadiiye.
Degi-inigwele, anmar Bab-Jesús-nuggindi, machergan omegansuli geg gued, degi, omegan machergansuli geg gumogad.
Ar igi ome macheredgi daniki, deyob machered omegi gwalulenonimogad. Ar degite belagwapa Bab Dummadgi danimalad.
Bemar-sunnad nue itomarmogana, ¿ar wede nabiri ome Bab Dummadse nono-dunwarsuli goled?
¿Ar macherganga gusgu igar maisursi, sailagia-suitigwar gwen nabiridsurye, na wargwen binged amiedye?
Ar omegangardina sailagia-suitii-saed bur nabirid, ar sailagia ega uklesad, nono edugegar.

Ar degite, dule-wargwen we-igargi abin-abin sunmakbiele, unnila an bemarga sogdo, anmar igar-baidgi gwen odurdakdisurye, degi, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad danar-ambikunoni-damalad, Bab Dummadse goledsik, igar-baid nikasurbarye.
Jesús-burgwisad-e-binsaega gwenadgan noar nanadimalad
We-ibmar an bemarga sogsokalidsikdi, an bemar-nug gwen odummosurmardo. Ar bemar ambikualile, an itogua, gwen ibmar-nuedga be ambikusurmalad, ibmar-ichogega be imakde-damalad.
Anga sogmardo, bemar Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad danar ambikunonikile, na be danar-danar abinsabukwa-gud-damarye. An insagua, ar bemar abala deyob gubuk an insado.
Ar dakargua, bemar-abargi na danar-danar ambikuer-gebed, adi mag daklegegar, doamar nue Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-sunnadi.
Ar bemar danar ambikunonimalale, bemar Bab-Jesús-burgwisad e-binsaega mas-gunye sogmalan-inigwele, gwen aga be ambikunoni-dasurmalad.
Ar bemar mas-gunned-wachi mosale, gwenna-gwenna na eginbi binsamarsoggu, abala amba ukumada besdamalad, abala, doggusadba, mungud-damalad.

¿Ar bemar neg-niksursi, na be-neggi mas gunmalagar, degi, be-neggi na be gobmalagar? Ar bemar degi-daed-ulale, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-Bab-Dummadse-golega-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-e-nug bemar ichobukmalad, degine, gwenadgan-wilemalad obingesabukmalad. ¿Igi an bemarga sogo be insae, an be-nug odummomaloe? Suli, wesikdi geg an be-nug odummomalad.
Bab-Jesús-burgwisadgi-binsaega mas-gunmalad-igar
Bab-Jesús-sunnad anga uksad, a an bemar-odurdaksamarmogad: Dummad-Jesús darba-uklesad mutik, madu susa-gusad,
Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsad-sorba, madu biske-biske imaksad, degi, sogded: “Be gunmar, we an-san, bemar-ular weyob ichimaksad. Weyob be imakdii-gumalo, adi bemar an-insamalagar.”
Mas-guchad-sorba Jesús amba deyob nog susbar. Geb sogdebar: “We-gobeddina an-abegi Bab Dummad dulemar-ebo igar-bini-mesisad-e-wilubganad. Gobed-irba weyob be gobmaloed, adi angi be binsamalagar.”
Degisoggu, we-madu be gunnarmalale, degi, we-gobed be gobbarmalale, Bab-Jesús-burwisad-igar bemar oyonaid, Bab-Jesús-gannar-danikoed-ibase.
Degisoggu, doa-dule igarsuli, dodoakwaa we-madu guchale, degi, igarsuli gobed gobsale, a-dule Bab-Jesús-abegi, degi, e-sangi nue iskusdo.
Degisoggu, a-ulale wargwen-wargwen na be dukin ulubgi dakmar, na be iskudii-dibe, geb a-sorba madu gunnoed, degi, geb a-sorba be goboed.
Ar dule-wargwen iskued-nika we-madu gunnele, degi, gobele, Bab-Jesús-sangi binsasulid-ular, na dukin san wiononikoed.
A-ulale bemar bukidar ueledimalad, degi, yegus be itodimalad, deginbali, bukidargus burgwemarsunnad.
Ar an na dukin-dukin ulubgi na dakmalana, Bab-Jesús sabsur anmar-odurdaknai-gussuliled.
Ar Bab-Jesús anmar wilub-daker, anmar iskus-dibe, igi, iskussur-dibe, anmar-odurdaknonisunnoed, adi mer anmar dule-baigan-Bab-Jesúsba-naisurmaladba degi-sadegu sabsur odurdaklesii-gumogagar.
Degisoggu gwenadgan, bemar danar mas-gunnega ambikunonikile, na be muchub-muchub edarbemar.
Ar dule-wargwen ukurba-itogele, na e-neggi mas gundo, adi mer Bab Dummad bemar-sabsur-odurdakmalagar, bemar danar ambikumalar. Igar-baigandi an modapile, an bemarga nudakdapoed.
